body:
Warns the party away, attacks through a blizzard and later reacts to damage to her home.

Recorded role and choices

In April 2025, Baba Yagá threatens the adventurers, gives a brief countdown and calls an ice storm onto the company. A later April 2026 appearance records her anger over her home. These quest acts support a recurring named antagonist; the familiar folkloric name does not import every story or power associated with Baba Yaga elsewhere.

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.
